entries.description: Added RoundRectangle method to PdfContentByte with Bezier corner arcs, radius clamping, and negative radius handling.
Added ScaleToFill method to Image class. Uses Math.Max ratio (vs ScaleToFit's Math.Min) and applies unconditionally (scales up or down).

Added 7 RoundRectangle tests (operators, curve count, line count, radius clamping, zero radius, start point, negative radius) and 5 ScaleToFill tests (scale up, scale down, exact fit, aspect ratio, asymmetric target).
S03_LinesAndShapes: Added 'Rounded' rectangle to Section 4 row. S05_Images: Added ScaleToFill mode (with clipping) alongside Stretch/ScaleToFit/ActualSize.

Created src/DabblerPdf/Text/TextLayout.cs with WrapText, MeasureHeight, CountLines, and DrawText methods. WrapText handles explicit newlines, word-wrapping, and single long words. DrawText supports Left/Right/Center alignment in PDF coordinates.

Added 18 tests in TextLayoutTests.cs: WrapText (8 tests: short text, exact fit, multi-word, long word, explicit newlines, double newlines, empty string, very narrow width), MeasureHeight (3 tests), CountLines (2 tests), DrawText (5 tests: left/right/center alignment, multi-line Y return, default leading).

S02_TextWrapping: Replaced SampleBase.WrapText/DrawWrappedText with TextLayout.WrapText and TextLayout.DrawText. Added Section 4 demonstrating all three alignment modes (Left/Center/Right). Section 5 uses TextLayout.MeasureHeight for CanGrow demo.

Created src/DabblerPdf/Pdf/IPdfPageEvent.cs with OnOpenDocument, OnStartPage, OnEndPage, OnCloseDocument default interface methods.
Added PageEvent property to PdfWriter.

Integrated OnOpenDocument into Open(), split AddPage into EndCurrentPage/StartNewPage for correct page numbering, added OnEndPage/OnCloseDocument to Close(). Restructured Document.NewPage() to fire OnEndPage before page number increment and OnStartPage after.

Created tests/DabblerPdf.Tests/Pdf/PageEventTests.cs with 9 tests: callback ordering (1/2/3 pages), page number correctness, DirectContent drawing in OnStartPage and OnEndPage, null PageEvent safety, and partial implementation with default interface methods.
Refactored S07_MultiPage to use HeaderFooterPageEvent implementing IPdfPageEvent. Replaced manual DrawPageHeader/DrawPageFooter calls with event-driven header/footer rendering.

Created src/DabblerPdf/Pdf/PdfTemplate.cs with Width, Height, Content properties. PdfTemplate is backed by a PDF Form XObject with BBox, /Type /XObject, /Subtype /Form. Tracks its own font resources for the resource dictionary.

Added CreateTemplate(width, height) and AddPageTemplate(template) to PdfWriter. Templates are serialized as Form XObjects in Close() after all content is finalized. Added template tracking list and counter.
Added AddTemplate(PdfTemplate, x, y) to PdfContentByte. Emits q/cm/Do/Q operators. Modified SetFontAndSize to route font registration through template when Content belongs to a PdfTemplate.
Added CanEncode(char) method to BaseFont. Added comprehensive XML docs to WinAnsiEncoding, IdentityH, and CreateFont explaining encoding limitations and the CanEncode helper.

Created PdfTemplateTests.cs with 10 tests: template creation (2), content writing (2), AddTemplate operators (3), Form XObject structure (2), Page X of Y integration (1). Added 4 CanEncode test methods with 16 cases to BaseFontTests.cs.

S07_MultiPage: Replaced pre-calculated SetTotalPages with PdfTemplate pattern. HeaderFooterPageEvent now places a template for total page count, filled in after all pages. S01_BasicText: Added encoding section showing CanEncode results for ASCII, accented, Euro, and em dash characters.
